```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, shiny, plotly, DT)
```

```{r}

# Define UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("NYC 311 Complaints Dashboard"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("borough", "Select Borough:", 
                  choices = unique(data_1$Borough), 
                  selected = "Manhattan",
                  multiple = TRUE),  
      
      selectInput("complaint", "Select Complaint Type:", 
            choices = c("All Complaints", unique(data_1$`Complaint Type`)), 
            selected = "All Complaints",
            multiple = TRUE),
      
      sliderInput("dateRange", "Select Date Range:", 
                  min = min(data_1$`Created Date`, na.rm = TRUE), 
                  max = max(data_1$`Created Date`, na.rm = TRUE), 
                  value = c(min(data_1$`Created Date`, na.rm = TRUE), 
                            max(data_1$`Created Date`, na.rm = TRUE)))
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("complaintPlot"),  # Output for the interactive plot
      DTOutput("dataTable")           # Output for the filtered data table
    )
  )  # <- Closing sidebarLayout()
)  # <- Closing fluidPage()

# Define Server
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  # Reactive dataset based on user selection
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    data_1 %>%
      filter(Borough %in% input$borough,
             `Complaint Type` %in% input$complaint | "All Complaints" %in% input$complaint,
             !is.na(Duration),  # Remove rows with NA in Duration
             !is.na(`Created Date`),  # Remove rows with NA in Created Date
             `Created Date` >= input$dateRange[1] &
             `Created Date` <= input$dateRange[2]) %>%
      mutate(Duration = as.numeric(Duration))  # Ensure Duration is numeric
  })
  
  # Aggregated data for plotting (Calculate the mean duration per borough)
  aggregated_data <- reactive({
    filtered_data() %>%
      group_by(Borough) %>%
      summarise(Average_Duration = mean(Duration, na.rm = TRUE))  # Calculate mean of Duration for each borough
  })
  
  # Render Interactive Plot
  output$complaintPlot <- renderPlotly({
    data <- aggregated_data()  # Store aggregated data
    
    # Prevent empty dataset errors
    if (nrow(data) == 0 || all(is.na(data$Average_Duration))) {
      return(NULL)  # No data to plot
    }
    
    # Create the plot with aggregated data
    ggplotly(
      ggplot(data, aes(x = Borough, y = Average_Duration, fill = Borough)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +  # Use "identity" to plot pre-aggregated data
        labs(title = "Average Response Time by Borough", 
             y = "Average Duration (Days)", x = "Borough") +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +  # Format y-axis labels with commas
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    )
  })
  
  # Render Data Table
  output$dataTable <- renderDT({
    datatable(filtered_data(), options = list(pageLength = 10))
  })
}

# Run the Shiny App
shinyApp(ui, server)

```
